IC1: - Able to provide written informed consent in English.
IC2: - Willing to have height [OR] and weight measured and provide demographic information (e.g. age, race, sex)
IC3: - Experience heartburn symptoms at least 2 days a week during the past 3 months.
IC4: - Use OTC product(s), supplements, [OR] or dietary manipulation to relieve heartburn symptoms in the last 3 months.
IC5: - Willing to take the study soy supplement before resorting to OTC product(s) to control heartburn symptoms.
IC6: - Willing to complete questionnaires, [OR] records, [OR] and diaries associated with the study and to complete all clinical visits.
IC7: - Willing to provide information about dietary intake; 3-day online 24-hr recalls during baseline, intervention, [AND] and washout.
IC8: - Willing and able to provide a valid social security for study payment purposes.
